  echo: false

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
nba_recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")
glimpse(nba_recruits)
```

```{r}
summary(
  nba_recruits |>
    select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted)
)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

basketball_tibble <- nba_recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c(
        "Never played",
        "Brief career",
        "Solid career",
        "All-Star level",
        "Superstar"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c("#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
notable_players <- basketball_tibble |>
  filter(
    name %in% c("LeBron James", "Chris Paul", "Kevin Durant", "Dwight Howard")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label_x = case_when(
      name == "LeBron James" ~ 8,
      name == "Kevin Durant" ~ 15,
      name == "Chris Paul" ~ 24,
      name == "Dwight Howard" ~ 8
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      name == "LeBron James" ~ 24.7,
      name == "Kevin Durant" ~ 20.5,
      name == "Chris Paul" ~ 18.2,
      name == "Dwight Howard" ~ 15.5
    )
  )

basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(
    data = notable_players,
    aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = notable_players,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  )
```
